result.Method of Attack: Use of preinstall hook in package.json to execute arbitrary code upon installation; execution of obfuscated JavaScript file (deference.js) that downloads and runs malware; on Windows, writes and executes a batch file (data.bat) that downloads a malicious binary from matrixane.com and runs it via rundll32, replaces package.json with pk.json to cover tracks; on macOS (and non-Windows, non-Linux systems), creates a directory in ~/Library/Application Support/UpdateProvider, copies a local file test-config.ts renamed as updateMacOs, executes it silently with nohup, then deletes deference.js
result.Attack Vector: npm package installation with preinstall script hook
Indicators of Compromise: Files: deference.js, data.bat, data.tmp, pk.json, package.json replacement
File: test-config.ts renamed to updateMacOs executed on macOS
